name: Instance
description: Instance running on a server, such as a Docker instance.

name.label: Name
name.help: Use a stable host-like name for the instance.

uuid.label: UUID
uuid.description: Unique identifier from the master instance.
uuid.help: Generated by the master instance when applicable.

description.label: Description
description.help: Use this field for a short operational note.

last_synced.label: Last sync
last_synced.description: Date of the last automatic instance status synchronization.
last_synced.help: Updated by the status synchronization action.

up.label: Online
up.description: Indicates whether the instance is online.
up.help: Updated according to the latest status retrieval.

url.label: URL
url.help: Base URL used to contact the instance.

server_id.label: Server
server_id.description: Server on which the instance runs.
server_id.help: Select the host server for this instance.

user_id.label: API access user
user_id.description: User used by the remote instance to access this instance API.
user_id.help: Created automatically when the instance requires API access.

access_token.label: API token
access_token.description: Token used to access the remote instance API.
access_token.help: Used as bearer token for remote API calls.

managing_agent_id.label: Managing agent
managing_agent_id.description: Managing agent related to the instance.
managing_agent_id.help: Set for agency instances when a managing agent is known.

user_token_generated.label: User token generated
user_token_generated.description: Indicates whether the user access token has been generated.
user_token_generated.help: False means the access token can still be generated.

has_dns_record.label: DNS record
has_dns_record.description: Indicates whether the instance has a DNS record.
has_dns_record.help: False means the DNS record still needs to be created.

refreshed.label: Refresh date
refreshed.description: Date of the last instance status refresh.
refreshed.help: Updated by the main instance status refresh action.

refreshed_logs.label: Refresh log
refreshed_logs.description: Human readable log of the instance refresh.
refreshed_logs.help: Contains details about failed or missing checks.

branch_equal.label: EQual branch
branch_equal.help: Used together with the related branch checks.

branch_fmt.label: FMT branch
branch_fmt.help: Used together with the related branch checks.

statuses_ids.label: Technical statuses
statuses_ids.description: Technical status history of the instance.
statuses_ids.help: Shows the latest technical status snapshots.

checks_ids.label: Checks
checks_ids.help: Shows the current boolean checks created by synchronization.

action.create_user_token.label: Create user access token
action.create_user_token.description: Create an access token for the instance user.

action.create_dns_record.label: Create DNS record
action.create_dns_record.description: Create a DNS record for the instance.
